name: Vithal Kamat's (Bhubaneswar-Puri Road)
area: Cuttack-Puri Road, near Jatri Niwas — Bhubaneswar side of Dhauli
signature_dish: South Indian breakfast — dosa, idli and filter coffee
why_it_matters: Dhauli — the Ashokan rock edict and Peace Pagoda — has no proper restaurant at the site itself, so day-trippers eat on the Bhubaneswar-Puri road that runs past it. Vithal Kamat's, a branch of the long-established vegetarian family-restaurant chain, sits on this road and is one of the closest reliable, hygienic sit-down options, listed about 1.1 miles from the Peace Pagoda on Tripadvisor.
insider_tip: Eat here before climbing to the Shanti Stupa — there is no full meal at the hilltop, only the view. The pure-veg South Indian breakfast is the strong suit; it is a safe-stomach choice for travellers continuing on to Puri. Honest note: this is a Bhubaneswar-Puri highway eatery serving Dhauli visitors, not a Dhauli-village restaurant.
signature_address: Vithal Kamat's, Cuttack-Puri Road, near Jatri Niwas, Bhubaneswar, Khurda District, Odisha 751002

name: Brothers Dhaba (Bhubaneswar-Puri Road)
area: Lakshmi Sagar, on the Bhubaneswar-Puri road toward Dhauli
signature_dish: North Indian dhaba-style curries and tandoor
why_it_matters: A dhaba on the Bhubaneswar-Puri road on the city outskirts, well placed for travellers running the Dhauli day-trip or continuing toward Puri — Tripadvisor reviewers explicitly note the location is good for people heading to Puri. It offers both AC and non-AC seating and is one of the nearer full-meal options to the Dhauli edict site, which itself has no restaurant.
insider_tip: Convenient as a lunch break when combining Dhauli with a Puri trip rather than as a destination in itself. The North Indian dhaba menu is the staple. Honest note: this is a Bhubaneswar-fringe highway dhaba, not a Dhauli-site eatery — at Dhauli proper, expect only tea and snack carts near the parking area.
signature_address: Brothers Dhaba, Lakshmi Sagar, Bhubaneswar-Puri Road, Bhubaneswar, Khurda District, Odisha 751006
